title: feuilleea incana
intro:
Feuilleea incana, commonly known as Frostweed or White Frostweed, is a perennial herb native to North America, characterized by its small white flowers and unique ability to "weep" or seep a white, frost-like substance when injured or damaged.

This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Feuilleea incana include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and astringent properties, making it useful for wound care and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpenoid saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
